newsitem.title: OMAN: Britain's Prince Philip tours Omani coast.
newsitem.headline: Britain's Prince Philip tours Omani coast.

text.p: Britain's Prince Philip on Friday toured Oman's coast on the latest leg of an international tour as honorary president of the Geneva-based World Wide Fund for Nature, the official Omani news agency ONA said.
He arrived in the Gulf Arab state from neighbouring United Arab Emirates on Thursday.
The visit is part of a tour that includes trips to Turkey, Mongolia, Japan, Russia, the United States and Canada.
